regions.merged_text: Congratulations on your Birth-day -- another year's service in the good God's wonderful universe. I meant to call you up last night the first I knew it was so late that I just decided not to call. I do hope that you enjoyed the day and especially with the folks last night. . . . Jerry called me from Notre Dame but I rather fear I was a disapointment. I did what I think was best under circumstances. I am glad he caled. Some day --- God willing -- things will be different.
